description_zh: 自主穿梭车在停止标志路口直行通过时，一辆左转车辆抢行导致碰撞，ego为直行的穿梭车，NPC从右侧横向路口左转冲突。

source_snippets: a Beep - operated autonomous shuttle was proceeding in autonomous mode straight E/B after stopping at a 3 - way stop intersection when a vehicle making a left turn heading N/B proceeded out of turn resulting in a collision within the intersection.
MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION: PROCEEDING STRAIGHT: VEH 1 (checked), MAKING LEFT TURN: VEH 2 (checked)
TYPE OF COLLISION: HEAD - ON: VEH 1 (checked), BROADSIDE: VEH 2 (checked)
Shade in Damaged Area: Diagram shows a vehicle with shaded areas on the right front and right rear
evidence.reason: AV 直行通过三向停止路口，另一车违规左转导致碰撞，选取 AV 为 ego，另一车为横向左转冲突 NPC，对应 junction_turn 原语。
